post.instagram:
I had the whole conversation planned. I opened my mouth and said “because I said so”.

Most of us have rehearsed it all day. Then they look up, the wrong words come out, and the row ends up being about your tone rather than the phone.

So we made scripts. Word for word.

1. What to say.
2. What not to say.
3. Why it works.
4. What to do after.
5. You can rehearse it out loud before you need it.

And when you tell us which line actually worked, the next script you get is picked on that.

The words you have ready are the ones you reach for when you are tired.

What is the sentence you wish you could take back?

What stage is your child? Three questions, no sign up, link in bio.
